title: Metamorphojean
overview: Created as a series of fashion advertisements for Marithe + Francois Girbaud, Godard explores metamorphosis, identity and the langauge of images through is rhythmic editing and fragmentation. Treating clothing and everyday objects as signs to be deconstructed rather than products to be sold.
